method: Assistant-generated second-pass responses in this Codex conversation using the revised specialist instructions and the unchanged primary and contrast cases. No external API call or real organizational experiment was performed.
changes: Added explicit CURRENT READINESS, STRENGTHS, PRIORITY GAPS, ACTIONS AND OWNERS, BEFORE OFFLINE EVALUATION, BEFORE LIVE USE, SUSTAINED OPERATION, and REASSESSMENT sections.
Separated readiness for offline evaluation from readiness for live use and sustained operation.
Required unsupported ownership to be marked unknown rather than inferred.
stable_finding: Technology/application fit, human-review limitations, data and policy requirements, and the need to compare simpler workflows remain stable across cases.
changed_finding: Company A is conditionally able to prepare an offline evaluation, while Company B is not ready for live use and lacks enough ownership and capacity evidence to set a reliable evaluation start date.
improvement: The revised outputs rank readiness gaps, identify supported owner roles, separate offline/live/sustained gates, and preserve explicit missing-information requests.
remaining_limitations: The cases are hypothetical and do not establish actual organizational readiness.
No external evidence packet or independent organizational measurements were used in this run.
The proposed gates are management-design suggestions, not validated standards or observed test thresholds.
